name: Strix Halo 8060S ROCm 10.0 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 UD-IQ2_XXS depth-0 prefill
methodology: Protocol deterministic-prime-extend-completions-v1, runner local-llm-speed v1, measured at the OpenAI-completions API endpoint. Mean of 2 repeats after 1 warmup. Concurrency 1, so the figure is per-request, not aggregate. Depth is the primed KV prefix; at depth 0 the whole prompt is computed (actual cached depth 0, recomputed history 0). Prefill is effective follow-up prompt processing: uncached tokens divided by client-observed time to first output. Decode is client-observed generation throughput over the tokens after the first, so TTFT is excluded. KV cache type default, speculative decoding off.
